view_spec.special_token_evidence: Pinned SmolVLM2 tokenizer_config.json added_tokens_decoder special=True IDs exhaustively verified as 0..16 and 49152..49279; ID 2=<|im_end|> is also the pad token.
view_spec.mask_explanation: Native prefix padding mask: present camera tokens + actual language mask + state=True. Attention block boundaries keep image/language from attending to state/actions; expert uses prefix KV context and suffix mask. Masks are not attention probabilities.
view_spec.state_pipeline: Batch axis is added before native normalization; raw batched values were not separately captured. State projection input contains native right zero-padding.
view_spec.coordinate_convention: Legacy pre-PR-777 SO100: first five joints in calibrated degrees, gripper in calibrated percent (nominal 0–100). State is measured follower position; actions are absolute target positions.
view_spec.action_semantics: absolute target joint positions; predicted, not executed
view_spec.spatial_evidence: LeRobot 0.6.1 embed_image + Transformers 5.4.0 SmolVLMVisionEmbeddings.flatten(2).transpose(1,2), no CLS; connector.pixel_shuffle groups adjacent rows/columns. Geometry recorded at actual vision input. Index charts do not assert attribution.
view_spec.time_semantics: schedule_time is derived from native Euler schedule, not a recorded time tensor or physical robot time
view_spec.summary_method: Float32 reductions of detached actual tensors; population std, L2 norm; bounded previews and indexed last-axis norms. No full large activations.
